title: I spent years looking for training in coding and creating video games. And I haven't found anything yet until I discovered that AI can also create code for video games! Do you also code your games using AI?
author: Curious_Reputation15

comments.author: icekiller333
comments.body: I do indeed, with a focus on smaller games using html/js. I have a background in that so it helps me adjust things without relying on the AI (in this case Claude Sonnet 4.5) to do everything

comments.author: Bob_Fancy
comments.body: Are you really asking if anyone in sub called AI Game Dev uses AI to code their games?

comments.author: agarlington
comments.body: Yup! I don't solely rely on Claude or Replit to do everything for me, however I certainly leverage and utilize them. Been finding some really good tools lately, lmk if you want a list. Check out Summer Engine AI if you have time. It integrates a handful of AI models DIRECTLY into Godot for you, as well as having a site that has meshy integration for text-to-3d, image-to-3d, etc.. pretty darn neat. So if it doesn't make parts of the game for you, it will walk you through how to do it step by step!

replies.author: Leading_Ad_5166
replies.body: It's extremely easy to integrate Claude directly into your game system without using any external tools.  I use godot as well.  Without having a plug in, claude can scan the game files from the game's root directory and edit them directly: scenes, scripts, etc.  Very fast and effective.

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: Interesting, did not know that thank you! So it's as simple as something to do with an API key right?

replies.author: Leading_Ad_5166
replies.body: Yes, i'm vibe coding with claude sonnet 4.5, so i just told it what api key to use, and created some functions with the relevant parameters and the structure of the api call, then integrated it into the game.

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: damn, gonna try that then. thanks.

comments.author: Cautious_Cry3928
comments.body: I have a whole JRPG prototyped with AI. I coded it several years ago and threw it out while having a manic and psychotic episode. I just recreated it with AI.
